This guide will walk you through the process of deploying your online store using Stack 02, ensuring you have full ownership and control of your digital sales.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Many digital creators face restrictions from traditional payment platforms, limiting their ability to sell products effectively. COREMERCH’s infrastructure circumvents these limitations by leveraging decentralized payment solutions, allowing creators to accept cryptocurrency without the hurdles of KYC or account setups. This approach not only empowers creators by giving them full ownership of their stores but also ensures they can operate independently of fluctuating regulations and policies that often affect conventional payment services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up your crypto store on Cloudflare Pages, you need a few essential components. First, ensure you have a Cloudflare account to host your site. Next, gather your digital products, such as ebooks or courses, ready for upload. You will also need a NOWPayments account to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Familiarize yourself with Supabase for order management and Google Apps Script to handle your backend logic. Having these tools at your disposal will streamline the deployment process, allowing you to focus on building your store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your payment layer using NOWPayments. Create an account and set up your desired cryptocurrencies for transactions. Then, use Supabase to manage product data and orders, connecting it with your Cloudflare Pages setup to ensure seamless order fulfillment. Utilize Google Apps Script for backend automation, enabling instant delivery of digital products upon successful payment confirmation. This pipeline ensures that every purchase is processed efficiently, providing buyers with immediate access to their products.
Full ownership means you're in control of your store and data.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your crypto store is set up, it’s time to go live. Deploy your website through Cloudflare Pages and ensure that all links to your products are functioning correctly. Conduct a thorough test transaction using a cryptocurrency wallet to purchase one of your products. This step is crucial to confirm that the payment processing, product delivery, and order management systems are working in harmony. After a successful test, promote your store through social media and other channels to attract potential buyers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, focus on scaling your operations. Start by expanding your product offerings in Supabase and testing new payment methods with NOWPayments. Leverage marketing strategies to reach a wider audience, ensuring your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and transactions. Regularly monitor your payment and delivery pipeline for any issues. As your store grows, consider utilizing additional features from the Edge Commerce Stack to enhance your store's capabilities and maintain operational efficiency.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
